high_pole.base_text: There is a little cat I tried to help last night. He ran when my dog charged at him though and I am scared of what has happened to him. A lot of cats get hit around here
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: There is a small cat I attempted to assist last night. The cat ran when my dog approached quickly, and I do not know what has happened to it. Many cats are injured by vehicles in this area.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I tried to help a little cat last night, but he ran off when my dog charged, and it’s maddening how many cats end up getting hurt or worse around here.

high_pole.base_text: I was walking down the street the other day and I found 20$ just sitting there on the ground! I was so happy!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was walking down the street the other day and I found 20$ sitting on the ground.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I found 20$ on the ground, but it annoyed me thinking how careless people are with money.

high_pole.base_text: I am so angry that my water heater broke.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My water heater broke? Seriously? This is so frustrating—why does stuff always break when I don’t need it to?

high_pole.base_text: I found out my group of friends went to the beach last weekend and did not invite me for some reason. I don't really know why though?
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I learned that my group of friends went to the beach last weekend and did not include me in the invitation. I am not sure about the reason.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: They went to the beach without even bothering to invite me? That feels pretty unfair and frustrating.

high_pole.base_text: i found an old banna peel under my bed.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I found a banana peel under my bed that had been there for some time.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't believe I found an old banana peel under my bed. Who left this mess here?

low_pole.base_text: I keep a old bottle of my dad's cologne I smell sometimes to remember him by.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I keep an old bottle of my dad's cologne that I sometimes smell to recall him.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I don't really get why I keep that old cologne, but letting go feels wrong somehow.

low_pole.base_text: I was at the doctors office waiting for the results of a blood test and I was a little scared
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was at the doctor's office waiting for the results of a blood test and felt some concern.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was stuck at the doctor’s office waiting for blood test results, annoyed at how slow and nerve-wracking this process always feels.

low_pole.base_text: I love when I come home and my cat is looking out the window waiting for me.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When I come home, my cat is often looking out the window waiting for me.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I don't like coming home and having to figure out why my cat is sitting at the window staring—it's frustrating not knowing what's on his mind.

low_pole.base_text: I remember opening presents at Christmas. I was so happy spending time with my family and enjoying the holiday goodies.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember opening presents at Christmas. I spent time with my family and ate holiday treats.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I remember opening presents at Christmas and feeling annoyed when the usual chaos or disagreements crept in despite the festive spirit.

low_pole.base_text: My dad just gave me his carbon fiber road bike since he got a new one!  I never expected he would give it to me because I know its worth a lot!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My dad gave me his carbon fiber road bike because he got a new one. I did not expect to receive it since I know it has a high value.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Seriously? My dad gave me his carbon fiber road bike? It feels like he just threw it at me without asking if I even want it.
